W.note: Pastel pearl pill with blurred rotating aurora and slow exhale curves feels truly ethereal with good reduced-motion and focus handling, though the pale button has soft rest affordance.

X.note: Polished, accessible dark card with tidy glow and sheen and strong focus ring, but the hover is restrained and reads more refined than dreamy.

Y.note: Glassy button gets a pleasant luminous bloom on hover, but the small label and dull rest state weaken affordance and hierarchy.

Z.note: Clear gradient CTA with a slow drifting light bloom and long soft settle that feels dreamy yet obvious, with focus and reduced motion covered.
